data.description:
You love building something people can actually use: the moment an integration works, an agent takes a tedious task off someone’s hands, or an idea becomes a useful tool. At XALT, you work closely with the people you build for, taking their solution from the first conversation into production.

Your customers will be enterprises and public-sector organisations. Your focus will be AI agents with XALT Northstar or development platforms in the Atlassian ecosystem. We will work out together which area fits your experience and interests; working across both is possible. What you learn in customer projects will feed back into our own products.

What we are working towards

We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on.

What you will do

  • Turn business problems into practical technical solutions together with the customer.
  • Write production code and integrate agents into existing systems and workflows.
  • With a Northstar focus, build and operate personal and operational agents using MCP servers, Agent Skills, evals, guardrails and observability.
  • With an Atlassian focus, develop platforms and workflows using Forge, Rovo and CI/CD so development teams can use agents reliably.
  • Take solutions into production, evaluate their quality and improve them based on actual use.
  • Bring insights from customer projects into our products.

What you bring

  • Experience writing and reviewing production code, for example in TypeScript or Python, across both backend and frontend
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers and CI/CD, for example AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform or GitLab
  • Practical experience with LLMs and agentic systems, including evals that detect errors and regressions
  • At least one agent or AI workflow you have built yourself and put into production, which you can demonstrate live during the application process (see “Your AI example”)
  • Enjoyment of working directly with customers and the ability to make reasoned technical decisions with incomplete information
  • Business-fluent German and English

What we offer

  • Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools
  • €70,000–100,000 gross per year, depending on experience; we are open to going beyond this range for exceptional senior candidates with a proven record of running agents in production
  • The opportunity to follow your solutions from the first conversation into customers’ daily work and see the difference they make
  • Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution

### Your working arrangements

We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role.

  • Full-time
  • Work within an international company with teams in Munich, Leipzig, Manila and New York

### Our professional community

Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte.

Your AI example

We would like to understand how you approach problems and what you have learned along the way. Bring a process you have automated yourself with AI and show it to us live. Walk us through your contribution, whether the workflow works consistently, and what has measurably improved. We are also interested in its limitations and how you check the results. One example is enough; you can recreate it with test data. Please do not share confidential information or protected code.

Your application

Does this sound like work you would enjoy? We would love to hear from you. Send your CV to ----- and tell us what you would like to work on. The conversation should also give you room to ask about the team, your responsibilities and what you need to do good work. We will discuss the interview arrangements and your AI demonstration with you personally. You can also send any questions beforehand to -----

Gestalte die digitale Zukunft von Finance & HR aktiv mit!

Du möchtest nicht einfach nur bestehende Systeme verwalten, sondern Geschäftsprozesse aktiv verbessern, moderne Technologien vorantreiben und Verantwortung für eine zentrale Business-Applikationslandschaft übernehmen? Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für Dich sein.

Unser Kunde ist eine Organisation mit einem gesellschaftlich relevanten Auftrag im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. In einem dynamischen und technologieorientierten Umfeld werden digitale Lösungen entwickelt und betrieben, die einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Modernisierung zentraler gesellschaftlicher Strukturen leisten.

Im Mittelpunkt Deiner neuen Aufgabe stehen zwei zentrale Business-Applikationen: Oracle NetSuite und Personio. Beide Systeme sind bereits etabliert und sollen nun weiter stabilisiert, intelligent miteinander vernetzt und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Darüber hinaus spielen Automatisierung und der Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz eine zunehmend wichtige Rolle.

Zur Verstärkung des IT-Teams suchen wir eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, die Geschäftsprozesse versteht, gerne hands-on arbeitet und die Weiterentwicklung der Systemlandschaft aktiv mitgestalten möchte..

Deine Aufgaben

  • Systemverantwortung & Weiterentwicklung: Du übernimmst die Konfiguration, Administration und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Oracle NetSuite und Personio. Dazu gehören unter anderem Workflows, Formulare, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Saved Searches sowie Reports.

  • Business Process Management: Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen Finance, Controlling, Einkauf und HR analysierst Du bestehende Prozesse und Anforderungen und entwickelst passende technische Lösungen – von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Go-live.

  • Technische Verantwortung: Gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Teammitglied stellst Du den zuverlässigen Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung beider Applikationen sicher. Ihr arbeitet eng zusammen, vertretet Euch gegenseitig und gestaltet die Aufgabenverteilung eigenverantwortlich.

  • Steuerung externer Dienstleister: Bei komplexeren Entwicklungen und Schnittstellen arbeitest Du mit externen Implementierungspartnern zusammen. Du hinterfragst technische Konzepte, bewertest Ergebnisse und sorgst dafür, dass das Know-how langfristig intern aufgebaut und gesichert wird.

  • Integration & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst die Anbindung der Systeme an weitere Anwendungen weiter und identifizierst Potenziale für Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI, insbesondere in Finanz- und HR-Prozessen.

  • Application Management: Du analysierst und behebst Störungen, begleitest Changes und Releases und unterstützt den Betrieb weiterer Business Applications.

Das bringst du mit

  • Qualifikation: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit IT-Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Konfiguration, Administration und Weiterentwicklung von ERP- oder HR-Systemen mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit Oracle NetSuite gearbeitet. Kenntnisse in Personio oder vergleichbaren HR-Systemen sind ebenfalls willkommen.

  • Technisches Know-how: Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis von Skripting, beispielsweise JavaScript oder SuiteScript, SQL-Datenbanken und REST-APIs. Du kannst technische Anforderungen beurteilen und Dich souverän mit Entwicklern und externen Dienstleistern austauschen.

  • Prozessverständnis: Du kennst Geschäftsprozesse aus den Bereichen Finance, Controlling, Einkauf oder HR und verstehst es, fachliche Anforderungen in praktikable technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.

  • Persönlichkeit: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und IT-Kolleg etwas zu bewegen.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab.

Deine Vorteile

  • Sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Du arbeitest in einer Organisation, deren digitale Lösungen einen gesellschaftlich relevanten Beitrag leisten.

Who We Are

At Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. family, we're on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide.

By combining world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology, we deliver inclusive, culturally competent support that helps individuals and families navigate some of life's most important journeys.

With Progyny's support and global reach, we're expanding access to care and breaking down barriers so that more people can build the families they want, wherever they are in the world.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Lead Claims Operations to lead our small claims team, strengthen our global claims operations, and drive the development of the tools that support our members and team.

Our members come to us during one of the hardest phases of their lives. A fertility journey is physically and emotionally exhausting, and a slow reimbursement or an unclear answer adds stress nobody should have to carry. That is why member experience sits at the heart of every claims process we run: we respond fast, we explain decisions clearly, and we treat every piece of member feedback as important. We want our members to feel the difference to a traditional insurer at every step.

This is a player-coach role combining team leadership, operational oversight, and product improvement. You’ll guide and develop the team, manage quality and workload, and continuously improve our processes. You’ll also stay close to daily operations by handling complex or escalated cases, reviewing selected claims, and stepping in during periods of increased demand. Your routine caseload will be significantly smaller than that of a Claims Processor, allowing you to focus where your experience and judgement have the greatest impact.

Working closely with the VP Member Experience, Legal, Clinical Operations, and Finance, you’ll help maintain a fair, consistent, and compliant claims framework across our markets. You’ll bring practical judgement to reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation, recognising country-specific requirements and knowing when specialist input is needed.

You’ll also drive the continuous development of our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet in partnership with Product and Engineering. You’ll translate operational and member needs into clear requirements, help prioritise improvements, and ensure new features meet those requirements before launch.

We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic leader who combines strong analytical skills with precision and attention to detail. You’ll enjoy being close to the work, use data to guide decisions, take ownership of improvements, and understand the impact every claim can have on a member’s journey.

What you will do

Team leadership and daily operations

  • Lead and develop our claims team through coaching, feedback, and regular quality reviews.

  • Coordinate workloads, priorities, and coverage to meet service levels and maintain a sustainable workload.

  • Handle complex or escalated cases, review selected claims, and support processing during periods of increased demand.

  • Define clear targets and SLAs for the team, such as turnaround times, processing accuracy, and member satisfaction. Track them continuously, report on progress to the VP Member Experience, and drive measurable improvements quarter over quarter.

Process improvement and member experience

  • Use operational data and team insights to identify recurring issues and improve workflows across markets and product lines.

  • Maintain consistent claims decisions, clear documentation, and effective escalation and quality-assurance processes.

  • Ensure members receive accurate, timely, and empathetic communication throughout the claims journey.

Claims products, wallet, automation and AI

  • Drive improvements to our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet with Product and Engineering, and identify where AI can make claims work faster and more accurate.

  • Define product requirements and acceptance criteria, including where AI may support a decision and where human review remains mandatory, and help prioritise enhancements based on member needs, operational impact, data protection, and risk.

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, validate features before launch, and prepare the team through updated workflows and training.

  • Monitor results after launch, including the quality and accuracy of AI outputs, and drive further improvements.

Claims framework, regulatory requirements, and controls

  • Review provider contracts, invoices, and claims documentation for market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, involving Legal, Clinical Operations, or Finance where needed.

  • Maintain the claims framework and translate agreed requirements into practical workflows, controls, and guidance.

  • Partner with Finance on payment accuracy and reconciliation, support audits, and address control or compliance gaps.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience in claims, healthcare benefits, reimbursement, insurance operations, or a related field, including three years coordinating or leading a team.

  • Hands-on expertise in complex claims, quality assurance, operational controls, and financial reconciliation.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, ideally in operational workflows such as document processing or case handling, with a clear sense of where human judgement and data protection require oversight.

  • Experience reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation against market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, recognising when specialist input is needed.

  • Experience defining product requirements with Product and Engineering, testing new features, and supporting operational rollouts.

  • Experience improving processes and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, ideally within a technology company or scale-up.

  • Strong analytical skills, precision, and attention to detail, using operational KPIs to guide decisions and improvements.

  • Clear communication, sound judgement, and a collaborative, empathetic leadership style focused on the member experience.

  • Professional fluency in English.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Make deals: negotiate prices, contracts and work closely with our Sales team to identify and seize market opportunities.

  • Establish and maintain international supplier relationships as part of our strategic procurement, purchasing a seven-figure trading volume per month.

  • Find new partners internationally, for example via trade shows or cold calls, and build these up into long-lasting relationships.

  • Resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders that block revenue.

  • Follow spot market trades, price dynamics and trends, and act on them at high speed.

  • Work with advanced AI tools that keep you a step ahead of the market.

Who You Are

  • You think like a trader. You like buying and selling and ideally have made money before, for example through trading, your own business, a side hustle or a sales role.

  • You want to win. You chase deals and results without waiting to be pushed.

  • You act fast. You decide and follow up.

  • You have a natural curiosity. You always ask how and why, and you learn fast from every conversation.

  • You are comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external parties in real-life meetings or (video) calls.

Background

  • You are fresh out of university, or you have a couple of years of work experience in a commercial role, for example sales or trading. Any industry works.

  • Self-employment, your own business or a side hustle is very welcome. We look for people who drive commercial value, understand trade and know how to create revenue.

Required Qualifications

  • You have a university degree.

  • You have strong analytical and negotiation skills, and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision.

  • You bring a hands-on mentality: you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings.

  • You are curious about AI and how it changes the way we trade.

  • German post: You speak German at C2 level (mandatory) and English fluently.

  • English post: you speak English fluently. Italian is a plus, and so is any other European business-fluent language.

What’s In It for You

  • Real ownership from day one - shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company.

  • Learn from the best - work directly with senior operators, interact with skilled industry leaders and CEOs on a daily basis

  • Competitive compensation - attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program.

  • Personal growth & visibility - rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team.

  • Vibrant company culture – modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites.

Why Join

You’ll be joining a company that’s not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI.
Here, you won’t just manage supply chains - you’ll help redefine how global commerce operates.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €70K – €90K

data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform: we design and develop the platform; stellarator researchers and engineers use it to mature the design of Alpha and Stellaris; you will imagine and build with us novel solutions for simulation tools that spark joy and reduce time-to-insight

  • Accelerate Stellarator R&D, at the company at its forefront: we work side by side with researchers and engineers to ensure what we build immediately boosts the speed Proxima Fusion’s Stellarator design program

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will join the Simulation Platform Team, a software platform team that balances development of core products with direct support to researchers, adapting to the Stellarator design program’s strategy and priorities. In your first six months you will e.g. add features to our in-house simulation pipeline automation system and ensure that AI agents can work with it efficiently.

  • On the platform engineering side you will design, develop and maintain next-generation software solutions for stellarator simulation and design, targeted to human and agentic use; for example:

    • Python libraries enabling automation of large-scale simulation workflows

    • cloud-based data storage that keeps everyone in sync

    • web applications that foster cross-domain collaboration and knowledge discovery

    • integration of AI tools where they actually provide leverage

  • You will also work together with our researchers to apply our tools to specific use cases, working as an internally-deployed Research Software Engineer: you will guide users to make the most of the available simulation tooling and proactively co-develop applications that unblock their R&D program, while gathering precious feedback and ideas for the next platform improvements

WHO YOU ARE

  • We are looking for a software practitioner with a user-first mindset, interested in tackling a diverse mix of challenges: from the optimization of scientific computing workflows to building cloud- and web-based systems for data management, sharing and exploration

  • Proficient in Python

  • You enjoy staying up to date with current software development best practices and tools, e.g. agentic development or modern data pipelines and scheduling solutions

  • You enjoy diving into new problems with a continuous learning attitude, absorbing relevant domain knowledge in a dynamic start-up environment; no fusion background needed, familiarity with scientific software use cases is a plus

  • Familiarity with one or more of the following is desirable but not required: full-stack web development (React, TypeScript, FastAPI), Pydantic, JAX, cloud services and cloud-based applications; data management systems

  • You don't need to tick every box. If this role excites you, please apply

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30-45 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)


*This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. As part of the integrated stellarator design team you will work in between plasma physics and technology and make sure that all stellarator systems are designed according to clear and optimal design criteria. You will ensure that modelling uncertainties are quantified and used appropriately. You will drive projects where overarching design solutions with multi-system trades need to be found.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Ensure interfaces, design criteria, load cases and uncertainties are correctly defined: so that engineering design can iterate quickly and with clear assumptions.

  • Understand systems interactions: in order to minimize unintended consequences of the main architectural decisions.

  • Solve integration challenges: Identify, track, and solve the hardest integration challenges and risks of a machine not achieving its mission requirements.

  • Harness simplification opportunities: Identify, track, and address the most promising opportunities that affect the Alpha architecture.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You've earned your engineering judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace or Formula 1.

  • You are not afraid of different physics domains. You feel comfortable navigating the different physics regimes of a Stellarator - from waves propagating in a plasma to cryogenic properties of steel.

  • You reach for whatever tool fits. Being a pen-and-paper calculation, a simulator you coded last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse.

  • You build consensus. You are a low-ego high-clarity communicator who works effectively with multiple technical leads, to bring integration challenges and system-level tradeoffs to a clear decision.

  • You commit to a concrete outcome. Every study, tool, and memo you produce ends in an actionable insight and a clear next step, otherwise it didn't happen.

Deine Rolle

Unsere Kunden lernen uns meist persönlich kennen: auf sechs bis neun eigenen Events im Jahr, die meisten davon in München. Dazu gehört das Commerce Impact Forum, bei dem Geschäftsführer und CIOs aus Handel und Industrie zusammenkommen. Außerdem Webinare, Messen und unsere Inhalte auf LinkedIn und im Blog. Als (Senior) Marketing Manager planst du das mit der Geschäftsführung, setzt es selbst um und sorgst dafür, dass aus Teilnehmern Gespräche werden.

Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast viel Raum, Prozesse und Formate selbst aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du planst mit der Geschäftsführung, welche Events, Webinare und Messen wir im Jahr machen, und setzt sie um, bei Bedarf mit Unterstützung aus dem Team.
  • Du bist am Puls der Zeit: Du verfolgst, was in der Branche passiert, und bekommst Input aus dem Team, der Geschäftsführung und Projektleitung. Daraus machst du Inhalte und verantwortest dafür alle unsere Kanäle, etwa LinkedIn für das Unternehmen und die Geschäftsführung, Blog, Newsletter und Website, und alles, was künftig dazukommt.
  • Du verantwortest unsere Marketing- und Outreach-Prozesse: wie wir Kontakte gewinnen, im Blick behalten und an den Vertrieb übergeben, einschließlich der Automatisierung dahinter.
  • Du wertest aus, was funktioniert, und entwickelst unser Marketing mit neuen Formaten und Ideen weiter.
  • Du steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn wir sie für Design oder Produktion einsetzen.

Dein Profil

data.description:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

As a (Senior) Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

  • You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment.

  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

  • You are fluent in both German and English.

  • You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week.

⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.

  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀

Aufgaben

  • Strategieerarbeitung: Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Account Managern, um Werbepotenziale auf Amazon optimal auszuschöpfen und auszubauen.
  • Keyword-Recherche & SEO-Optimierung: Durchführung von Keyword-Recherchen sowie On- und Offpage-Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kampagnenleistung.
  • Kampagnenoptimierung: Maximierung des Kampagnenpotenzials durch fortlaufende Optimierung und Überwachung der Kampagnen, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
  • Datenanalyse & Maßnahmenableitung: Analyse der Kampagnendaten mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Performance.
  • Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege von Reportings zur transparenten Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Erfolge der Kampagnen für den Kunden.
  • Amazon Seller Central: Nutzung und Verwaltung des Amazon Seller Central zur Überwachung und Steuerung von Kampagnen.
  • PPC-Optimierung: Anpassung und Optimierung der PPC-Preise auf Basis zuvor festgelegter Strategien, um die Effizienz und den ROI der Werbemaßnahmen zu maximieren.

Qualifikation

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Kaufmann/-frau für E-Commerce oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich.
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben effizient und selbstständig zu bewältigen.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themenfelder einzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen.
  • Team- und Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist in der Lage, dich klar und präzise schriftlich sowie mündlich zu äußern.
  • Analytisches Denken: Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Zahlen und die Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen, zeichnen dich aus.
  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Deine schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation ist klar und gut organisiert.
  • Technisches Know-how: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint gehören zu deinem Repertoire, um Kampagnenanalysen und Präsentationen professionell zu erstellen.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
  • Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
  • Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
  • Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben.

data.description:
Wir suchen dich für ein spannendes Praktikum im Grafikdesign, um unser Team bei der Entwicklung kreativer und ansprechender Designs für unsere Kunden zu unterstützen. Du wirst visuelle Konzepte für verschiedene Kanäle gestalten und dafür sorgen, dass die Marken unserer Kunden auf Plattformen wie Amazon überzeugend präsentiert werden. Dabei entwickelst du individuelle Grafiken und Layouts, optimierst bestehende Designs und arbeitest eng mit internen Teams sowie Kunden zusammen, um ihre Vorstellungen professionell umzusetzen.

Aufgaben

  • Amazon-Design: Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von visuellen Inhalten für Amazon, einschließlich Produktbildern, A+ Content, Werbebannern und Infografiken zur Optimierung der Conversion-Rate.
  • Markenidentität: Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung und Pflege konsistenter Markenidentitäten für unsere Kunden durch kreative und innovative Designkonzepte.
  • Optimierung: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Account Management und dem Performance Marketing Team, um sicherzustellen, dass die Designs strategische Ziele unterstützen und die Sichtbarkeit auf Amazon erhöhen.
  • Trendbeobachtung: Aktive Recherche von Design Trends und Best Practices, um stets aktuelle und relevante Designs für Amazon zu liefern‍.
  • Feedback-Management: Anpassung von Designs basierend auf Kundenfeedback und den spezifischen Anforderungen der Plattform.

Qualifikation

  • Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in im Bereich Grafikdesign oder einem verwandten Studiengang.
  • Kreativität: Du bringst ausgeprägte kreative Fähigkeiten mit und hast erste praktische Erfahrungen im Grafikdesign, idealerweise ergänzt durch ein Portfolio, das deine Arbeiten zeigt.
  • Technische Kenntnisse: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Grafik Design-Programmen wie Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch, um Ideen und Konzepte klar zu präsentieren.
  • Detailorientierung: Hohe Aufmerksamkeit für Details und die Fähigkeit, qualitativ hochwertige Designs unter Einhaltung von Deadlines zu liefern.‍
  • Interesse an E-Commerce: Grundkenntnisse über Plattformen wie Amazon und deren Anforderungen an Design sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • Teamkultur: Ein unterstützendes und kreatives Team mit offener Kommunikationskultur.‍

data.description:
Who we are

CEPA Study Abroad is a U.S. based study abroad organization that partners with schools to develop and run custom faculty-led programs in over 40 countries. CEPA was founded in 1997 and operates study abroad programs across Europe, including European Study Centers in France and Germany. Our main administrative offices are in Besigheim, Germany and Strasbourg, France. CEPA also partners with the CEPA Foundation to provide service-learning opportunities in Costa Rica, Peru, and Guatemala, programs that align with our organization’s commitment to environmental and humanitarian engagement.

We are a small marketing team, very much mission and values driven, focused on building collaborative relationships and providing meaningful and challenging study abroad programs that enable students to broaden their global perspective, deepen their knowledge, and develop personally and professionally. We are committed to social responsibility and environmental sustainability and have been offsetting our carbon footprint since 2019.

CEPA Study Abroad joined Terra Education in 2026, giving the organization the opportunity to expand its study abroad programs to additional destinations outside of Europe, working alongside our colleagues at Terra who have long-standing expertise in Africa, Asia and Central & South America.

Your Role and Responsibilities

For our team in Besigheim, we are looking for a motivated working student with an interest in IT, digitalization, and artificial intelligence, who is keen to gain practical experience in a modern, international work environment.

In this role, you will not only contribute to ongoing IT projects but also actively support the implementation of new digital solutions and AI applications that are set to transform the way we work within the company.

Your tasks

Depending on your interests and current needs, you will support us with tasks including:

  • Maintaining and further developing our Microsoft 365 environment

  • Setting up and configuring hardware and software

  • Providing first-level support to employees with technical questions

  • Supporting IT projects and rollouts

  • Analyzing, documenting, and automating workflows

  • Implementing and using AI solutions such as MS Copilot

  • Digitalizing and optimizing internal processes

  • Researching and evaluating new technologies and AI applications

  • Creating instructions, training materials, and documentation

Working hours: up to 20 hours/week during the semester, more hours possible during semester breaks by arrangement. Duration of the contract: initially 6 months with the possibility to extend.

What you bring to the table

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program (ideally in your first semester) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Informatics, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable field of study in the Heilbronn, Ludwigsburg, or Stuttgart region

  • Enthusiasm for digitalization, modern IT solutions, and AI technologies

  • Practical and solution-oriented approach to work

  • Interested in taking on responsibility to take on responsibilities and drive projects forward independently

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English skills

  • Friendly demeanor and enjoyment of working with international teams

  • Current enrollment at a university

What you can expect:

  • Exciting practical experience in the future-oriented fields of IT, digitalization, and AI

  • Participation in real projects with tangible benefits

  • Direct insight into strategic digitalization initiatives

  • High degree of autonomy and short decision-making processes

  • Flexible working hours that can be combined with your studies

  • International work environment with colleagues in Europe and the USA

  • Modern IT infrastructure and the opportunity to actively shape new technologies

  • Personal and professional development

  • Optional: Provision of a furnished room in a shared apartment

Why us?

The Stuttgart/ Heilbronn region is currently developing into one of Germany’s most exciting hubs for AI and innovation. We want to actively leverage this environment and are looking for students who wish to put the knowledge gained from their studies and research into practice. At the same time, we offer the opportunity to play a direct role in the digital advancement of an internationally active company.

Do you want to go beyond just studying AI—do you want to apply it in a real-world context? If so, we look forward to receiving your application.

data.description:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.
  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab
  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL
  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1
  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.
  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt
  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche
  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen
  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools
  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge
  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad
  • Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara
  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel
  • Teamgespräch vor Ort
  • Angebot

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

data.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

  • Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups)

  • Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management

Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit.

Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen.

Rohlik Group is Europe's leading online grocery delivery service. Using technology, we deliver a weekly shop of 25,000 SKUs in under three hours, in 15-minute delivery slots — giving our customers back their time, freedom and flexibility.

In every city we operate, we handpick the best and freshest local produce — from butchers to bakeries — and work directly with farmers through our Farm-to-Door program, alongside the trusted brands and affordable own-label products our customers love.

About the Team

The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.

The Role

As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network — from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Your projects will span both hardware (robotics, automated material handling, conveyor and packing systems) and software (control logic and orchestration optimisation), using whichever combination best solves the problem.

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

data.description:
Introduction to the Team & Role

 
What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
 
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
 
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.
 

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
  • Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

What You'll Do
Within 1 month, you will:
  • Know the team, the stack, and the cross-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
  • Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
  • Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.

    • Within 3 months, you will:
  • Have taken one major cross-functional change from plan to done
  • Own the full vendor-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.

    • Within 6 months, you will:
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
  • Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
  • Have a 12-18 month roadmap, setting the high-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio

    • Within 12 months, you will:
  • Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
  • Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
  • Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations

    • The Skill Set
  • 5+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate. 
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
  • Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead-to-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
  • Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
  • You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
  • You drive  strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
  • Run vendor evaluations end to end
  • Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.
  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L

    • What We Offer
  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits: Work From Home perks, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 
  • Balance: Flexible hours, Total work from home possible anywhere in Germany 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

    • Interview Process
    1. Call with the Talent Acquisition Manager
    2. Discovery Interview with the Hiring Coach (VP of Operations)
    3. Case Study with the Hiring Coach and future Team
    4. Clarification Interview with Future Direct Reports
    5. Convexity Culture  Interview
    6. Offer!
    Get ready using our Knowledge Base: https://bit.ly/42H1ggC
     
    Who We Are
    360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

    360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

    Learning Includes Everyone.
    In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

We are hiring a Lead Employment Counsel to be the first line of legal support for our People team. This person will advise directly on employment matters, manage our key legal and HR vendor relationships, and reduce our reliance on outside counsel. This is a hands-on, embedded role for an attorney who wants to operate as a trusted business partner, not a gatekeeper. The right candidate will have a passion for People and a strong legal background.

What you'll be doing:

  • Serve as the first line of support for employment legal questions, resolving most matters directly rather than routing them to outside counsel.

  • Partner with each People Business Partner to advise on employee relations, performance management, terminations, leaves, and accommodations. Manage severe employee relations cases directly.

  • Own the Remote.com relationship, including contract terms, service levels, escalations, and ongoing performance.

  • Own the external legal counsel relationship, including a clear evaluation of scope, spend, and who we engage with

  • Partner with Legal and Finance on cross-functional projects involving employment law, compliance, or spend.

  • Ensure compliance with employment law across every jurisdiction where Camunda operates, including in the DACH region. Find opportunities to reduce risk or balance risk with business value.

  • Identify and adopt AI tools that make legal support to the People team faster and more effective.

  • Ensure AI use is in compliance with local laws and regulations.

  • Track and reduce external counsel spend against a clear baseline.

What you bring:

  • J.D. or equivalent law degree, with active bar admission in at least one jurisdiction.

  • 8+ years of employment law experience, including significant in-house experience at a global, multi-jurisdiction company.

  • Experience managing outside counsel and HR vendor relationships, including EOR platforms such as Remote or similar.

  • A track record of advising HR and People teams directly, and translating legal risk into practical, business-pragmatic guidance.

  • Strong judgment and comfort making autonomous calls without escalating every matter to outside counsel.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve legal or compliance workflows.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to build trust across People, Legal, and Finance.

  • Interest in growing your career within HR/People.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-JS1 #LI-Remote #C1

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here
